name: HandleResult
reason: Names the widened return type of handleIntent so failures after a recorded action outcome or refusal carry optional actions (D3).
hostAction: None; existing Result<Handled> consumers remain compatible.

name: handleIntent
reason: Widens the failure branch to HandleResult with optional actions when a render fails after recording an action outcome or refusal (D3).
hostAction: None; store handled.actions when present on failure so recorded outcomes survive a failed render.

name: SurfaceCoreOptions
reason: Adds optional `limits` (`ValidateTreeOptions["limits"]`) so a surface core passes host validation bounds to `validator.validateTree` (D5).
hostAction: None; defaults remain 5,000 nodes, 64 depth and 1 MiB when `limits` is omitted.

name: createRenderer
reason: Adds optional `limits` (`ValidateTreeOptions["limits"]`) on `SurfaceProps`, forwarded to the surface core on each arrival (D5). Adds optional `invalid` (`"fallback" | "keep-last"`, default `"fallback"`): `keep-last` keeps the last accepted tree drawn, silent and marked `data-lf-stale`, after a rejected arrival (035 T5, A4).
hostAction: None; pass `limits` on `<Surface>` when the backend raises tree validation bounds. Pass `invalid="keep-last"` to keep the last tree on screen after a rejected arrival; the default still draws the fallback.

name: workerRunner
reason: Adds optional `startTimeoutMs` (default 5,000) to `workerRunner` defaults while moving the per-render `timeoutMs` timer to start when the worker reports `ready` (D6).

name: PreviewProps
reason: Adds optional `limits` (`ValidateTreeOptions["limits"]`) on `PreviewProps`, forwarded to each cell's `<Surface>` (F4 / D5).
hostAction: None; pass `limits` on `<Preview>` when the preview session raises tree validation bounds.

name: Preview
reason: Accepts optional `limits` on `<Preview>` and forwards it to each cell's `<Surface>` (F4 / D5).
hostAction: None; pass `limits` on `<Preview>` when the preview session raises tree validation bounds.

name: conformancePage
reason: The page's `mount(tree, styles, invalid?)` takes an optional `"fallback" | "keep-last"` mode so `rendererBrowserSuite` can prove keep-last (035 T5, A4).
hostAction: None; existing pages and suites call `mount(tree, styles)` unchanged.
